text:
Karina M: Quick ask 1 page one-pager for enterprise prospects focused on: security posture, SLA/availability language, and deploy-mode decision guide. Will be used as webinar leave-behind, CTAs on benchmark blog, and AE handout. Keep it skimmable.

Samir: Important: legal wants conservative claims. Use qualitative SLA wording on the one-pager, link to the actual SLA doc.

Jess: I can produce copy. Idea: header + 3 blocks (Security, Performance, Deployment). Each block 3-4 bullets + one customer-facing talking line.

Anil: For the benchmark blurb, suggest a micro-chart but keep numbers directional: e.g., "Representative: 4k-token chat workload 1 Dedicated median p99 < 250ms; batching+cache reduced median token cost ~2.7x vs uncached baseline". Add footnote to link to full methodology.

Olivia: For distribution tags: use campaign=enterprise-onepager-2026 and lead_tag=enterprise-snapshot. Also capture deploy_preference values. I'll implement in forms.

Marco: Design asks: 1) compact deploy-mode matrix (three columns) 2) micro-benchmark sparkline 3) security icon row. Keep color palette minimal.

Jess: Draft copy idea (bulleted):
- Security: SOC2 certified, VPC / customer VNet, optional customer KMS/HSM integration, audit logs & retention controls.
- Performance: Dedicated pools for predictable throughput, autoscaling burst options, SLA-backed targets for committed customers.
- Deployment: Hosted API for fast POC, Dedicated for production throughput, Private for on-prem & air-gapped needs.

Samir: For the SLA line use: "SLA-backed availability and latency targets available for Dedicated deployments". No numeric SLAs on the one-pager without legal sign-off.

Karina M: Add two quick sales soundbites for AE: 
1) "Same API across Hosted, Dedicated, Private 1 pick the control surface you need."
2) "Built-in fallbacks keep applications online if capacity or region is constrained."

Anil: Micro-benchmark footnote text: "Representative internal benchmark. Actual results will vary by model, prompt, and hardware. See full brief for methods."

Jess: Ill produce v1 copy and upload a PDF by EOD. Will leave placeholders for numbers that need legal review.

Olivia: I'll wire lead capture so downloads set tag enterprise-snapshot and add a deploy_preference field if filled. Also add UTM for paid social.

Marco: Noted. Will deliver two visual options by Thursday morning.

Samir: Routing: once tagged, route to /ae-enterprise in SFDC and set high-touch lead score if company size > 500 and deploy_preference != hosted.

marketing-bot: Reminder created for legal review at 2054678960.

Karina M: Timeline check: Jess draft by EOD Wed, design Thursday, legal Thurs morning, final asset Friday AM. Everyone OK?

Jess: Yes. Uploading draft to drive: https://drive.company/assets/enterprise-snapshot-v1.pdf (placeholder).

Olivia: I'll start the landing page and CTA wiring after Jess uploads final PDF.

Karina M: Thanks all. Keep copy tight, bullets only, 30-second read target. We'll iterate copy splits for security-first vs ops-first in A/B tests once we have baseline metrics.
